report.rationale: The incident report describes a confirmed embolic stroke temporally linked to an unflagged rapid-ventricular-response atrial fibrillation episode, which is a serious patient-safety risk. The synthetic CI test log (ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-0050) shows that the VTach sensitivity dropped from 0.97 to 0.89 in the v3.3.0-rc1 candidate build, triggering an automated risk-gate block before deployment. However, this regression was not caught by existing unit tests (ARTIFACT-TESTLOG-0042), indicating a coverage gap. The synthetic deployment log (ARTIFACT-DEPLOYLOG-0006) shows the update was pushed outside the maintenance window without proper change approval, which is a procedural issue but does not directly impact patient safety in this case.
